incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - SLO p99 latency > 5s for inference-prod-east-1 (incident INC-8921) -> paging eng-oncall :rotating_light:
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-8921 created - service: inference-prod - urgency: high - triggered by alert: p99_latency(5m) > 5s. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-8921
amanda: ack'ing INC-8921 - I'm on it, jumping into logs now :eyes:
oncall-bot: Amanda is now the primary oncall (shift: amanda).
amanda: quick check - is this across all models or a subset?
dylan: I see traffic spike to the llm-v2 route in east-1, p99 ~7.2s on the dashboard. other regions normal.
amanda: thanks. Dylan can you confirm if autoscaler kicked?
dylan: autoscaler did not scale up - metrics show < 10% spare capacity but queue depth climbed. suspect hotkey / batch coalescing issue.
jessica: tagging in. if autoscaler didn't spin up, maybe a quota or throttling on nodepool. Miguel from infra - any API errors for node creation?
miguel: checking cloud logs - got a couple 429s from cloud provider during nodepool expand at 12:03:21Z. rate limit + transient failures.
amanda: ok so timeline: traffic spike -> batcher coalesced big batches -> GPU mem pressure -> increased latency -> autoscaler tried to add nodes but hit provider 429 -> no capacity added -> tail got worse.
amanda: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) reduce max_batch_size to cap mem usage 2) enable temporary fallback routing to smaller model (llm-v2-tiny) for non-SLAd customers 3) escalate nodepool quota with cloud support if needed
dylan: I can push batcher override:
```bash
# temp override via runtime API
curl -X POST https://runtime.internal/api/v1/config -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"max_batch_size": 32}'
```
amanda: do it. also set kv-cache-ttl to 30s? larger cache might be causing bigger KV footprints.
dylan: applying overrides now...
dylan: applied max_batch_size=32 and kv_cache_ttl=30s. rolling config to east-1 pool.
oncall-bot: Deploy started: config-rollout/1749009992 by dylan -> status: IN_PROGRESS
oncall-bot: Deploy status: SUCCEEDED -> config-rollout/1749009992 rolled to 12/12 nodes in east-1
dylan: metrics - p99 dropped from 7.2s -> 4.8s after rollout. p95 ~1.1s improved.
amanda: good. second mitigation: enable routing fallthrough to llm-v2-tiny for non-SLAd traffic. Dylan, can you add a route rule?
dylan: adding rule: route where customer_tier != "enterprise" -> model=llm-v2-tiny ; priority low; dry-run=false
dylan: rule added and active. traffic % shifted ~18% to tiny model. p99 further down to 3.2s overall.
jessica: Miguel, cloud side - can you confirm if quota increases are in flight?
miguel: opened ticket with provider (TKT-5544) and requested emergency quota bump. provider acknowledged, ETA ~30-45m. also I see a transient failure window at 12:03 that looks like control-plane API rate limiting from our automation.
amanda: PD status: INC-8921 acknowledged by amanda. Escalation not needed yet.
pd-bot: Incident acknowledged: INC-8921 - Acknowledged by amanda at 1749009999
amanda: customer impact assessment: preliminary - ~12% of requests in east-1 saw >2s degradation, ~2% hit >5s and some timed out. most enterprise traffic pinned to dedicated pools unaffected. flows to public API and small customers impacted.
jessica: can we run a targeted warmup for dedicated pools to relieve load? maybe bump min_replicas temporarily for enterprise to avoid any spillover?
amanda: enterprise pools already pinned, but I'll increase reserved capacity on public pools by 2 nodes (hot spare) if provider allows. Miguel can we preemptively create 2 small instances in same AZ?
miguel: starting instance spawn for 2 small GPUs now - but might hit the same rate limits. trying using alternate project credentials to avoid automation throttles.
amanda: timeline note to PD: initial alert at 1749009992, acknowledged at 1749009999, batcher override rolled at 1749010100, routing fallback at 1749010305.
dylan: small regression: one worker showed OOM during rollout, auto-restart fixed it. log snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T12:12:10Z worker-17 ERROR OOM trying to allocate 1.2GiB
stack: ...
```
amanda: noted. that's why we lowered max_batch_size.
jessica: monitoring - set alert to quiet threshold for PD so we don't autopage again during stabilization (short window). will re-enable after 30m.
pd-bot: Auto-suppression enacted for INC-8921: suppress duplicate p99 alerts for 30m as requested by jessica.
amanda: handing off to jessica for post-incident followups and customer comms. I'll stay available for the next 20m.
jessica: taking the handoff. I'll coordinate postmortem and outreach to impacted customers, and keep this thread updated. please drop any logs/links here.
amanda: sending relevant dashboards + quick logs: https://dashboards.internal/board/p99-east-1?from=1749009300&to=1749012000
amanda: logfile tail: 
```
[12:02:58Z] incoming: /v1/generate 1200 req/min
[12:03:05Z] batcher: coalesced batch size 512 (target 128)
[12:03:21Z] autoscaler: nodepool expand request -> provider 429 rate_limit
[12:03:40Z] p99 latency spike to 7.4s
```
jessica: thanks — I'll pasteables into postmortem doc and include actions: 1) add guardrails to batcher to prevent >256 coalesce 2) add retry/backoff to nodepool expand and fallback path 3) implement PD suppression policy refinements 4) run chaos test on provider rate limiting
miguel: cloud provider confirmed eventual quota bump; new nodes booting. ETA ~18m.
jessica: current customer impact: reduced to <1% requests >5s after mitigations. continuing to monitor. will close PD when all metrics stable for 30m.
amanda: thx everyone. small followup: Dylan please open a tech debt ticket to add a soft cap on coalescing and a circuit for autoscaler failures.
dylan: will do - TICKET INF-3451 created. link: https://issues.internal/INF-3451
